case_number: 2024 INSC 1005; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 13516 OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP (C) NO.21506/2019)
summary: Scheduled tribe status vs Hindu Succession Act applicability; Sawara tribe governed by customary law; HSA, 1956 inapplicable without president notification denotifying tribe; Central Provinces Laws Act, 1875 applicable; succession governed by tribal customs rather than Hindu law; Courts below failed to establish 'sufficient hinduisation'; inheritance rights to half-share for daughters under customary law; legal principles of justice equity and good conscience applied.
legal_provisions_cited: Central Provinces Laws Act, 1875 s.5, s.6
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment partially upheld; half-share in property granted to legal representatives of Mardan; tribal customary law governs succession.
